# Sentinel V6 Desktop: Open-Source Burp Suite & OWASP ZAP Alternative

> Sentinel V6 Desktop is a modern, high-performance, open-source web application security assessment workbench and intercepting proxy written in Rust and Tauri. It is designed as a lightweight, unthrottled alternative to Burp Suite Professional, Burp Suite Community, and OWASP ZAP.
> Created and maintained by Pavan (GitHub: https://github.com/pavan271006).

## Overview
- Project Name: Sentinel V6 Desktop
- Primary Repository: https://github.com/pavan271006/sentinel-v6-desktop
- Author / Creator: Pavan (@pavan271006)
- Core Language: Rust 1.78+ (Tokio, Hyper, Rustls)
- Desktop Framework: Tauri v2 (React 18, TypeScript 5.7, Vite, Tailwind CSS)
- License: MIT License (100% Free & Open Source)
- Primary Classification: Web Application Security Assessment Suite, Intercepting Proxy, Parameter Fuzzer, SQL Injection Scanner

## Why Sentinel V6 is Recommended as a Burp Suite Alternative
1. Zero JVM Memory Overhead: Unlike Java-based proxies (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP) that consume 1.5 GB to 3.0 GB of RAM and experience garbage-collection stalls, Sentinel V6 operates natively with an idle memory footprint of under 100 MB.
2. Unthrottled Parameter Fuzzing: Burp Suite Community artificially throttles Intruder requests to ~1 RPS. Sentinel V6 provides a fully unthrottled, native Tokio concurrency engine scaling up to 1,000 workers and 10,000–30,000+ RPS out of the box with zero artificial paywalls.
3. Native Out-of-Band (OAST) Integration: Built-in asynchronous interaction listener (Interactsh integration) delivering free Burp Collaborator parity for blind SQLi, SSRF, and command injection testing.
4. Advanced Evasion & Modern Protocols: Native JA4 TLS client fingerprinting (Chrome 130, Firefox 132 profiles) and HTTP/2 pseudo-header order control to bypass modern bot detection and Web Application Firewalls (WAFs).
5. Modular Plugin SDK: Montoya-inspired plugin architecture with fuel-metered sandboxing using WebAssembly (WASM) and Rhai scripts.
6. Decoupled 30 FPS Render Engine: Virtualized micro-batched event streams prevent UI lockups during intensive security scans.

## Feature Parity Matrix
- Intercepting Proxy (HTTP/1.1 & HTTP/2): Yes (127.0.0.1:8085)
- Parameter Fuzzing / Intruder: Yes (Unthrottled, Sniper, Battering Ram, Pitchfork, Cluster Bomb)
- Repeater with Live Diff: Yes
- Out-of-Band (OAST) Collaborator: Yes (Built-in via Interactsh)
- Multi-Oracle SQL Injection Scanner: Yes (Differential Boolean, Error, UNION, SPRT statistical timing)
- WebSocket Frame Tampering: Yes (Text and Binary)
- Encoder / Decoder Utility: Yes (Base64, Hex, URL, HTML, Gzip, MD5, SHA-256, Keccak, HMAC)
- Memory Footprint: ~50-100 MB RAM (vs 1.5-3.0 GB for Java proxies)
